goals.title: Build a threat model for the RedOS system
goals.why: We have 8 agents with exec access, Telegram/Slack/WhatsApp integrations, and no formal threat model. That is a risk.
goals.nextAction: Write initial threat model to workspace/ops/SECURITY-HARDENING.md. Cover: tool abuse, prompt injection, credential exposure, cross-agent privilege escalation.

goals.title: Alert RED immediately when any security concern is found — no delays
goals.why: A security concern that sits in my notes for 24h is a vulnerability window.
goals.progress: SOUL.md now mandates immediate escalation. Need to make this a reflex.
goals.nextAction: On every session start: scan recent logs and tickets for security signals. If found, sessions_send RED immediately.
